Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨

Bible verse for burnout, when you keep saying you're good.

Exhausted after a third late night, he fell asleep in the office washroom and told his manager he was on a call.

Jesus: “Your place with Me was never earned by overtime. Even I stepped away to rest.”

“He gives power to the faint and increases the strength of the weak.”
Isaiah 40:29 (BSB)

Going home on time isn't quitting. It's trusting.
